text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can generate art, write stories, and even compose music. These programs learn from millions of examples and then produce something new. However, many people wonder whether machine creativity is the same as human creativity. While AI can copy styles and create impressive results, it does not have personal feelings or real-life experience. Human creativity comes from emotions, memories, and imagination, which machines cannot truly share. Perhaps the best approach is to see AI as a helpful partner rather than a replacement. By working together, humans and machines can create things that neither could achieve alone.
